name: OT cybersecurity
description: Security of industrial automation and control systems (IACS) across the lifecycle for offshore/onshore ICSS and SCADA.

specifications.value: ISA/IEC 62443 (world's only consensus-based IACS cybersecurity standard series); IEC recognised it as a horizontal standard in 2021; endorsed by the United Nations

62443-2-1:2024 (asset owners), 62443-3-2:2020 (risk assessment), 62443-3-3:2013 (system security requirements and security levels), 62443-4-1:2018 (secure product development), 62443-4-2:2018 (component technical requirements)

specifications.basis: ISA/IEC 62443 page: 'more than 50 member companies representing more than $1.5 trillion in aggregate revenue across more than 2,400 combined locations' and '31 different industries'

specifications.value: NIS2-compliant cybersecurity; IEC 62443-4-1 and IEC 62443-3-3 compliance; secure communication protocols and centralised Microsoft update deployment

applications: Security of industrial automation and control systems (IACS) across the lifecycle for offshore/onshore ICSS and SCADA.
notes: Page-read evidence from the 2026-11-24 comms-instrumentation.json sweep.
